newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville to fund some dam repairs directly.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville to fund some dam repairs directly.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Thursday it reached an agreement to improve efficiency at hydropower dams operated by the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation by directly funding project repairs.
The Bureau of Reclamation operates several hydroelectric projects in the Pacific Northwest, including the 7,000-megawatt Grand Coulee dam.
Before the agreement, maintenance and repair costs were funded through the federal budget process and then repaid a year later from BPA revenues.
BPA markets power produced at federal dams in the Northwest, which are operated by the Bureau of Reclamation and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.
The new system, which will cover a 10-year period starting from October, is expected to speed plant repairs and improve efficiency.
